summary: Prepare keyed mission selection and run-count maintenance with real Store parity controls

replay.detail: Default Store readers and runtime registration are unchanged. The opt-in source operator has no read/open history replay or implicit populated-source seed.

schema.detail: Explicit View registration creates local mission selection/count/dirty/clock tables, source triggers and ordered indexes. No default production schema version changes.

rules.detail: Canonical source admission, effective work state and checkpoint rules are unchanged. These local shadow outputs are not authority or a checkpoint coverage certificate.

compatibility.detail: No client route, cursor, socket protocol or work-action changes. The prepared selection interface preserves existing timestamp DESC/public-ID ASC seeks and filters before page slots; it does not certify complete mission cards.

downtime.detail: No production registration or reader activation. No additional restart or startup recovery work is introduced.

manual.detail: Consumer adoption must explicitly register the operator, certify complete projected-source dependencies, install populated state and process bounded source/clock pages before reading. Full card, work and authorization dependencies need separate proof.

recovery.detail: Prepared shadow rows persist and reopen controls pass. Incompatible source mutations remain fenced; populated installation, checkpoint adoption and cross-runtime restore/rollback activation are not certified.
